purpose: Independent completion and physical invariant audit; no new capacity predictor, no proxy tuning, no rewrite of registered main configurations
checks: 30 synthetic cases: finite quantities and all requested degradation-mode errors
Physical bounds across q=0 and actual charge endpoints of every recorded fit
Metamorphic invalid-theta tests: charge/program must not silently clip invalid states
CK0 holdout: no last15Ah fitting; validate tail predictions and root paths separately
Residual autocorrelation and n_eff profile thresholds
Every stage3 anchor/cell profile and target-envelope requirement
Stage4 exit/eligibility, protocol/sha commit order and pseudo-before-real order
Stage5 diagnostic intervals, cell limiting and recovery coverage
Bilingual final artifacts, protected tracked paths, clean study and branch push
selection: No main model changes or selection. Invalid or missing evidence means completion unproven until corrected or explicitly exited/capped per prompt.
exposure: exposed-exploratory; proxies are not hidden truth
causal_only: CK0 diagnostics may use prescribed reference anchors; no such fitted reference can be used before it is visible in a prediction.
